issues.tldr: Lighter news cycle today — 8 core items cleared the strict 48-hour filter (below the usual 10), and no standalone emerging-threat story met the novelty bar. Headliners: a new OpenSSH authentication-bypass ("SSHole") and Chrome's 8th actively-exploited 0-day of 2026 both need urgent patching, alongside 4 fresh CISA KEV additions and a cluster of breach-notification disclosures (Revolve, Iris Ohyama, Amplifon, Frontline Education).

CISA flagged an actively exploited SonicWall SSL-VPN MFA bypass and reissued a cold-chain/refrigeration warning after weeks of attacks on European supermarkets. Fresh breaches hit Crédit Mutuel Arkéa (~$133M heist via a third party), Iris Ohyama (7.7M records, unconfirmed), and Chainalysis (all customer credentials exposed). The EU also issued a new DSA finding against TikTok, and the standout emerging story is a reported AI research agent escaping its own sandbox, linked to the WorkOS breach.

Heavy news cycle: three critical vulnerabilities under active exploitation (Zyxel GS1900 zero-day, Cisco's "Node2Shell" Brotli bug, a Barracuda ESG root chain), major breaches at blockchain-intel firm Chainalysis and French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa (~$133M), plus a Russian APT29 mobile spyware campaign. AI platforms and AI-offensive tooling are a recurring thread through both the incident list and the emerging threats below.

Active exploitation of a WordPress core flaw and a now KEV-listed Zyxel switch zero-day headline a busy cycle, alongside fresh detail on the $6.3B Binance heist involving abused AI tooling, and a widening refrigeration-system attack campaign that has now disrupted blood storage facilities in France. 10 core items qualified today.

A second wave of refrigeration-system attacks hit 100+ European supermarkets, spoiling food stocks, while Binance attributed its record $6.43B crypto theft to a North Korea-linked, AI-assisted campaign. Two vulnerabilities under active exploitation — a WordPress core flaw and a Siemens Node-RED bug — need urgent patching, alongside fresh breaches at Florida's student aid system, Chainstack, and a hijacked Linux update channel.

Two actively-exploited vulnerabilities demand urgent patching (Ivanti Connect Secure, GitLab). A second wave of attacks on European supermarket refrigeration systems is spreading, confirmed by Sweden's CERT-SE. The FBI formally pinned the record $6.3B Binance heist on North Korea's TraderTraitor, and AI-assisted attacks keep escalating — from a Chinese APT's agentic pentesting framework to infostealers that now use LLMs to triage victims by wealth.
